portal_hypertension.title: Drug Development for MASH-Related Compensated Cirrhosis: Past, Present and Future.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Zeng RQ, Shao YX, Lin RT
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）引起的代偿性肝硬化是肝病学领域未满足的主要需求，迄今为止尚无批准的治疗方法。 临床提示：与非肝硬化MASH相比，代偿期肝硬化具有并发代谢功能障碍、持续性炎症、稳定纤维化和门静脉高压的特点，使得治疗开发具有实质性意义。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Compensated cirrhosis due to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) represents a major unmet need in hepatology, with no approved treatment to date. Compared with non-cirrhotic MASH, compensated cirrhosis is characterized by concurrent metabolic dysfunction, persistent inflammation, stabilized fibrosis and portal hypertension, making therapeutic development substantially more challenging. In recent years, several agents initially developed for non-cirrhotic disease have advanced into compensated MASH-related cirrhosis, including fibroblast growth factor 21 analogues, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor/glucagon receptor dual agonists, thyroid hormone receptor-beta agonists and ...

portal_hypertension.title: Characterization of the stages of chronic liver disease based on plasma proteins involved in systemic inflammation.
portal_hypertension.authors: Fortuny M, Torner M, Bermúdez-Ramos M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝硬化的特征是进行性纤维化、门静脉高压和肝硬化相关的免疫功能障碍，同时伴有全身炎症和免疫缺陷。 临床提示：尽管全身炎症在疾病进展和并发症中起着核心作用，但目前的预后评分并未纳入炎症生物标志物。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cirrhosis is characterized by progressive fibrosis, portal hypertension, and cirrhosis-associated immune dysfunction, combining systemic inflammation and immunodeficiency. Although systemic inflammation plays a central role in disease progression and complications, current prognostic scores do not incorporate inflammatory biomarkers. This study aimed to characterize stages of chronic liver disease (CLD) according to a panel of plasma proteins involved in systemic inflammation in patients with and without bacterial infection. Patients with CLD were classified according to clinical stages of cirrhosis and assigned to NON-INFECTION or INFECTION cohort. Baseline characteristics and routine infla...

portal_hypertension.title: An interpretable machine learning model for outpatient referral risk assessment in pediatric biliary atresia after Kasai portoenterostomy.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhang Y, Ke X, Liu J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 512）。核心观点：使用常规门诊数据开发可解释的模型，以协助 Kasai 门肠造口术 (KPE) 后胆道闭锁 (BA) 儿童的风险分层和转诊评估。 临床提示：这项多中心回顾性研究包括 512 名 III BA 儿童，他们在 8 个儿科中心接受了 KPE。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To develop an interpretable model using routine outpatient data to assist risk stratification and referral assessment in children with biliary atresia (BA) after Kasai portoenterostomy (KPE). This multicenter retrospective study included 512 children with type III BA who underwent KPE across eight pediatric centers. Clinical, laboratory, and ultrasonographic variables collected during outpatient follow-up were analyzed. Feature selection was performed using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator, and eight machine learning algorithms were evaluated. Model performance was assessed using discrimination, calibration, and decision curve analysis. The optimal model was further interprete...

portal_hypertension.title: Ten-year progression of Caroli's disease with portal hypertension despite endoscopic and pharmacological therapy: Implications for liver transplantation-A case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Meng H, Xie R, Yang C

portal_hypertension.abstract: Caroli's disease is a rare congenital disorder of the intrahepatic bile ducts that may be complicated by congenital hepatic fibrosis, portal hypertension, and recurrent variceal bleeding. We report the 10-year clinical course of a 29-year-old woman with Caroli's disease and portal hypertension who was managed in the Department of Gastroenterology. At initial presentation in 2015, she had splenomegaly, severe esophagogastric fundal varices, preserved liver biochemistry, Child-Pugh class A disease, and a low model for end-stage liver disease score.
